remarks: Surf City, Huntington Beach!! First time on the market in over three decades! This beautifully updated home in the resort style Villa Pacific reflects years of pride of ownership, with thoughtful improvements throughout. The updated kitchen features upgraded cabinetry and counters, recessed lighting, a newly updated oven and microwave, and sliding glass doors. Tile flooring and updated baseboards enhance the living and dining rooms, while luxury vinyl flooring, mirrored closet doors, and ceiling fans complement the bedrooms.
